phase_2_exit_requirements.claim: The accepted visual direction, design system, core flow and remaining Phase 2 handoffs are complete; this Gate does not re-accept design evidence.
A synthetic new user independently completes consent, onboarding, check-in, one deterministic result and first light through real Nest HTTP and PostgreSQL.
Same-day return through a second session reads the identical immutable result and interaction state.
Concurrent check-in, generation, task and light commands preserve one authoritative fact and stable conflict semantics.
Morning state, deterministic daily content, evening feedback and behavior remain separate authoritative records and projections.
Product-date boundaries, unknown outcomes and worker interruption recover the original intent without moving or duplicating facts.
Seven consecutive ProductDates produce seven real state slots, seven unique results and the accepted weekly projection without fabricated missing data.
DAY deletion blocks stale reads synchronously, removes authoritative and derived facts, survives Redis rebuild and leaves one explicit missing date.
The complete deterministic core E2E passes with real PostgreSQL 18, Redis 8, BullMQ 5, three Worker profiles, zero provider calls and retry zero.
